mapper.select: SELECT ADD_TAX_TYPE, MAX(EFF_DATE) AS EFF_DATE, MAX(TAX_RATE) AS TAX_RATE FROM TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE WHERE EFF_DATE <= #{happenDate} AND SCH_ID IN ( SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} ) AND EFF_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) FROM TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE TEMP WHERE TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE.ADD_TAX_TYPE = TEMP.ADD_TAX_TYPE AND TEMP.SCH_ID IN ( SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} ) AND TEMP.EFF_DATE <= #{happenDate} ) GROUP BY ADD_TAX_TYPE

SELECT SEQ_NO, BOOKSET_ID, BOOKSET_DATE, HAPPEN_DATE, O_CCY, VAT_TYPE, TAX_P_TYPE, INCOME_AMT_ALL, TAX_AMT_SUM, TAX_AMT, BOOK_ORDER, HAPPEN_AMT, BOOK_DATE FROM TAX_BOK_BALANCE_SUM WHERE HAPPEN_DATE = #{happenDate} AND BOOK_ORDER = #{bookOrder} AND BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

WITH TAB AS (SELECT TAX_ID, SCH_ID, ADD_TAX_TYPE, TAX_RATE, EFF_DATE, DANI.INSTITUTION_CODE FROM TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE TAS INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST DANI ON TAS.TAX_ID = DANI.BUSINESS_ID AND DANI.MODEL_TYPE = '02' AND DANI.DATA_TYPE = 'TAXADT' WHERE DANI.INSTITUTION_CODE IN ( #{createInst} ) AND EFF_DATE <= #{happenDate} AND SCH_ID IN (SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} )
UNION ALL
SELECT TAX_ID, SCH_ID, ADD_TAX_TYPE, TAX_RATE, EFF_DATE, NULL INSTITUTION_CODE FROM TAX_ADT_SCHEDULE TAS WHERE EFF_DATE <= #{happenDate} AND SCH_ID IN (SELECT SCHEME_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND SCHEME_TYPE = #{schemeType} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Data_Auth_Notify_Inst dani WHERE dani.business_id = TAS.tax_id AND dani.model_type = '02' AND dani.data_type = 'TAXADT' ) ) SELECT ADD_TAX_TYPE, MAX(EFF_DATE) AS EFF_DATE, MAX(TAX_RATE) AS TAX_RATE FROM TAB WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE = #{createInst} GROUP BY ADD_TAX_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT ADD_TAX_TYPE, MAX(EFF_DATE) AS EFF_DATE, MAX(TAX_RATE) AS TAX_RATE FROM TAB WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE IS null AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TAB TEMP WHERE TEMP.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{createInst} AND TEMP.ADD_TAX_TYPE = TAB.ADD_TAX_TYPE) GROUP BY ADD_TAX_TYPE
